title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
why: MiniWeb skill-primitive web benchmark plus MiniWebGen/MiniWebAgent: practice then compose browser skills; changes training data and planner/executor loop.
mechanism: Training/architecture: MiniWebGen synthesizes verified single-primitive browser trajectories; MiniWebAgent planner decomposes tasks into skill-level steps for a LoRA-trained executor (perceive–plan–act composition).
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 10 open-weight agents on 369 MiniWeb tasks (drag <=24%); Qwen3.5-4B +3.1K traj -> +24.9pp single-primitive on 13 held-out sites; MiniWebAgent +19.4pp held-out MiniWeb, +9.3 WebArena-Lite, +16.1 Online-Mind2Web, +20.0 WebVoyager without target traj training — author-reported, not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract (v1); project page BibTeX eprint 2610.35823 and results narrative
